# Which of your Postgres indexes are just costing you writes?

> Free Postgres index auditor: run one read-only query, paste the result, and see unused, duplicate, redundant and invalid indexes, the disk they waste and DROP INDEX statements to review. Runs in your browser, never touches your database.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
